us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Fast-moving Hawk Fire forces mass evacuations near Reno
bullets: Authorities urged about 90,000 people in Washoe County, Nevada, to evacuate or prepare to leave.
The fire began Saturday and grew across the Peavine Peak area with zero containment reported Sunday.
Nevada’s governor declared a state of emergency and mobilized the National Guard.

articles.title: Father of USS Abraham Lincoln sailor detained by Border Patrol
bullets: Luis Manuel Aviles was arrested in Key West, Florida, while his son remained deployed with the Navy.
His family says he has lived in the U.S. for 19 years and has a work permit.
DHS said he will remain in ICE custody while deportation proceedings move forward.

articles.title: Canada promises retaliation after new U.S. tariffs take effect
bullets: President Donald Trump’s 50% tariffs on some Canadian imports took effect Saturday.
Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada will impose dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs starting Sept. 8.
U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer blamed Canada for the breakdown in talks.

articles.title: Education Department moves to strip ABA law-school oversight power
bullets: Department staff recommended denying the American Bar Association’s renewed recognition as a law-school accreditor.
The ABA has overseen U.S. law-school accreditation for decades and currently accredits nearly 200 schools.
The recommendation cited concerns about independence and accreditation rules.

articles.title: U.S. prepares major Iran sanctions as markets watch Treasury
bullets: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was expected to announce new economic measures against Iran on Monday.
Iran warned it would respond harshly to expanded U.S. sanctions.
The announcement comes amid U.S. efforts to pressure Tehran over the Strait of Hormuz and the wider war.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: European leaders mark Ukraine’s 35th Independence Day in Kyiv
bullets: European leaders joined President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv for Ukraine’s Independence Day.
The visit came as Russia’s invasion continued and Ukraine reported intensified pressure on air defenses.
Reuters Connect showed multiple European officials arriving in Kyiv on Monday.
articles.source: AP / Reuters Connect / The Washington Post

articles.title: Iran warns support for new U.S. sanctions would be an ‘act of war’
bullets: Iran’s top security officials warned countries against backing new U.S. economic measures.
Tehran’s currency hit a record low ahead of the U.S. sanctions announcement.
Iran continues to link any resolution to the Strait of Hormuz and U.S. military posture in the region.

articles.title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake shakes Tokyo region
bullets: Japan’s meteorological agency said the quake was centered in southern Ibaraki prefecture.
More than 30 people were injured in the Tokyo region, according to AP reporting.
No tsunami warning was issued after the earthquake.

articles.title: EU and Russian aircraft help Serbia fight wildfires
bullets: Serbia continued battling major wildfires into Monday with international aircraft support.
Romanian firefighters and Russian water-bombing aircraft were among those assisting.
Serbian officials described the fire situation as extremely difficult.

articles.title: Japanese lawmakers visit Beijing to ease Taiwan-related tensions
bullets: Japanese lawmakers traveled to Beijing for talks with Chinese officials.
The visit followed tensions over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s comments on Taiwan.
It was the first such visit since the diplomatic fallout began.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Three Babbar Khalsa operatives arrested with explosives in Chandigarh
bullets: Police arrested three suspected Babbar Khalsa operatives in Chandigarh.
Investigators said 5 kg of explosives and guns were recovered.
Authorities suspect the accused planned to plant an IED in the city.

articles.title: Heavy rain disrupts Delhi flights and traffic
bullets: Fifteen flights were diverted from Delhi airport amid heavy rain.
The IMD issued a red alert for heavy rain and a yellow alert for moderate rain in several districts.
Road traffic was disrupted by waterlogging and jams across parts of Delhi-NCR.

articles.title: Paramilitary soldier injured as violence flares in Manipur
bullets: A paramilitary soldier was injured after firing broke out in Manipur.
Several houses were set on fire before the situation escalated Monday morning.
Journalists were present in the area when firing was reported.

articles.title: Three newborns die after ventilator blast triggers Maharashtra hospital fire
bullets: A ventilator blast triggered a fire in a Maharashtra hospital ward.
Doctors, nurses and hospital staff evacuated babies from the affected area.
Three newborns died after the incident.

articles.title: Assam-Meghalaya tensions hit tourism bookings
bullets: Nearly 90% of tourism bookings were cancelled, according to NDTV’s report.
The cancellations followed violence during a Khasi Students’ Union rally in Shillong on Aug. 19.
Tour operators said the unrest sharply affected travel sentiment in the region.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and stock-watch stories

articles.title: Nvidia slips ahead of pivotal earnings week
bullets: Nvidia shares were under pressure as investors awaited its quarterly results Wednesday.
The company remained central to the market’s AI-trade sentiment.
Broader Nasdaq futures also slipped as investors watched rates, Iran sanctions and tech valuations.

articles.title: SanDisk falls as AI-memory trade cools
bullets: AP reported SanDisk shares dropped about 5% in Monday trading.
The move came as technology and storage names weakened before Nvidia’s results.
The stock remained part of the broader AI memory-and-storage trade.

articles.title: Coherent drops more than 5% with optical stocks under pressure
bullets: AP reported Coherent fell more than 5% as tech stocks dragged on the market.
TradingKey also reported weakness across optical-communications names.
The move came despite strong longer-term investor interest in AI data-center optics.

articles.title: Corning slides as optical and glass names sell off
bullets: AP reported Corning shares fell about 3% on Monday.
Investing.com recently cited pressure tied to Apple supply-chain concerns and a fragile post-earnings setup.
The stock also moved with a broader pullback in optical-communications names.

articles.title: Micron weakens with memory-chip stocks
bullets: AP reported Micron Technology slipped about 3% Monday.
The decline came as AI-related hardware names pulled back ahead of Nvidia’s report.
Recent reports also cited patent-litigation risk as an overhang for Micron.

articles.title: RUM Group signs $13.7 billion AI cloud deal
bullets: RUM Group said it signed a contract worth about $13.7 billion with an unnamed U.S. cloud customer.
The deal covers access to GPUs and related services from its Georgia site under development.
RUM said it will need to raise debt or equity capital to fulfill the contract.

articles.title: Walmart to begin accepting Apple Pay and Google Pay
bullets: Walmart is moving to support Apple Pay and Google Pay, according to TechCrunch.
The change marks a shift for a retailer long focused on its own payment systems.
The rollout adds major mobile-wallet options for shoppers.

articles.title: TikTok reaches $400 million children’s privacy settlement
bullets: TikTok reached a $400 million settlement over a children’s privacy lawsuit.
The settlement ends litigation over claims tied to federal online privacy protections.
TikTok did not admit wrongdoing as part of the resolution.

articles.title: Tracsis completes Mistral Data acquisition
bullets: Tracsis announced completion of its acquisition of Mistral Data on Monday.
The company said FY26 performance was in line with market expectations.
Management said the deal strengthens its UK rail software platform.

articles.title: Shein seeks U.S. national-security review of Everlane deal
bullets: Shein voluntarily sought a CFIUS review of its $80 million deal to buy Everlane, according to Bloomberg cited by Techmeme.
The move is unusual because companies typically avoid extra CFIUS scrutiny unless required.
The deal comes amid heightened U.S. review of China-linked transactions.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories and AI developments

articles.title: Nvidia discusses Perplexity investment at $30 billion-plus valuation
bullets: Nvidia is in talks to invest in Perplexity, according to The Information as reported by Reuters.
The round would value the AI-search startup at more than $30 billion.
Perplexity declined comment, while Reuters said it could not independently verify the report.

articles.title: Inherent says its AI teammate outperformed OpenAI and Anthropic on research replication
bullets: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, announced benchmarks for an AI research teammate.
The company said its system outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI models on replicating research.
The report was published in TechCrunch’s AI coverage Monday.

articles.title: OpenAI backs strengthening California AI safety bill
bullets: OpenAI said California should strengthen an AI safety bill, according to TechCrunch.
The statement comes amid continued debate over state-level AI regulation.
The issue is part of a broader policy fight over frontier-model safety rules.

articles.title: Waymo hands over documents in NHTSA child-collision probe
bullets: Waymo provided documents connected to a federal probe involving a child collision.
The investigation is being handled by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
The case adds scrutiny to autonomous-vehicle safety and robotaxi operations.

articles.title: China’s robot makers push humanoids toward commercial work
bullets: Chinese robot makers showed humanoids performing parcel sorting, phone packing and household tasks in Beijing.
Reuters reported the demonstrations aimed to shift attention from spectacle to practical adoption.
Robotics firms are racing to commercialize physical-AI systems for industrial and service work.
